partnershipPlan: A patient partner with difficult venous access and the emergency nursing lead review the protocol's outcomes, especially the balancing outcome of extra needle sticks.
socialListening: No social media listening; anonymised emergency department complaints mentioning repeat blood tests over the last year are counted.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It takes them four tries to find a vein on a good day, so one draw from the drip is a mercy.
items.implication: Treat extra needle sticks as a real cost in the review.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: A rejected potassium in a patient with a wide QRS costs us forty minutes we do not have.
items.implication: Report sample rejection and redraws, not only haemolysis.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: After the cannula went in, the idea of another needle for bloods was too much for my son.
Composite paraphrase: We see the haemolysed tubes but not how they were drawn, so we keep arguing past each other.
items.implication: Add collection method to the request form for future monitoring.

summary: Four composite voices on needle sticks, delay, children and missing method data.
